changes: Use the company connector/account registry for call and recording sync and connection tests.
Bind downloads to the registered account and exact recording; missing URLs require an unambiguous registered account.
Refuse redirects and bound provider request duration.
Already-stored recording short circuit no longer requires provider credentials.

verification.strictTypecheck: passed for four handlers and imported helpers using the pinned SDK declaration shim

limitations: Local implementation only; no Edge deployment or hosted Auth/handler acceptance.
Actual account resolver check used existing service credentials for a read, not ordinary-user RLS acceptance.
Provider transport in handler tests was mocked; no real provider API, voicemail resource, audio download or paid processing was invoked.
Registry check is a read-time binding, not an atomic lease or per-page publication fence against concurrent reconfiguration.
The existing shared provider credential remains. Separate tenant credential provisioning and source reconciliation are still required.
URL compatibility sample covers 25 latest recording metadata rows, not every historical pointer.
No guarantee of live capture completeness, backup recoverability or audio playability.
